reasoning: The leaves display elongated, pale yellow/cream streaks running parallel to the leaf veins along the full length of multiple leaves, with alternating green and yellow banding. This regular, linear streaking pattern is the hallmark symptom of Sugarcane Streak Mosaic Virus (SCSMV), distinguishing it from the irregular mosaic blotching of Sugarcane Mosaic Virus or the marginal banding of Leaf Scald.
